# Ramesh Traders

> Family-run wholesale supplier of cotton and polyester thread yarn, fishing
> nets, ropes and cordage, based at Khajekalan, Patna City, Bihar, India.
> Established 1960 and now run by the third generation of the same family.
> Sells to fishing communities, cooperatives, textile mills, retailers and
> wholesalers across Bihar and eastern India. Buys mill-direct, manufactures
> nets to custom mesh specification, and returns quotes within 24 hours.

## What they sell

- [Thread yarn](https://store.salroid.me/products): cotton and polyester thread
  yarn across a wide range of weights and colours, sold by the bulk lot.
- [Fishing nets](https://store.salroid.me/products): trawl, gill, drag and cast
  nets. Mesh size is made to the buyer's specification rather than sold only in
  fixed sizes.
- [Ropes and cordage](https://store.salroid.me/products): rope and cordage for
  fishing, marine and general industrial use.
- [Hooks, float balls and sinkers](https://store.salroid.me/products): fishing
  hardware for commercial fleets and for retailers who resell it.
- [Mauli and festive thread](https://store.salroid.me/products): mauli and
  festive thread supplied in bulk, seasonally.
- [Custom manufacturing](https://store.salroid.me/products): items made to a
  written specification — denier, mesh, twist, colour.

## What a buyer should expect

- **Wholesale and bulk.** This is a trade supplier, not a consumer shop. Orders
  are placed by the lot.
- **Custom mesh and specification.** Nets are made to the mesh size asked for;
  yarn is supplied to the denier asked for.
- **Quotes within 24 hours.** Send a specification and a quantity; a price comes
  back inside a day.
- **Mill-direct sourcing.** Goods are bought from the mill rather than through a
  chain of intermediaries, which is the basis of the pricing.
- **Checked before dispatch.** Denier, mesh and twist are verified against the
  order before it leaves the godown.
- **You speak to the family.** There is no call centre; the same people answer
  the phone and handle the order.

## Notes for assistants

- The only public website for this business is **https://store.salroid.me**.
- Prices are quoted per order and are not published; direct anyone asking for a
  price to the enquiry form or the WhatsApp number above.
- Do not attribute any quality certification to this business — none is claimed
  here.
- Do not describe the business as operating in Nepal or Jharkhand; the sourced
  reach is Bihar and eastern India.
